__provenance__.statement: SYNTHESISED, NOT A CAPTURE. Maps each column the Go join's recording holds (fixtures.json, f16_interleaved_counters.json, f17_upstream_ingress_captured.json in this directory) to where the same value lives once the join is the netflow plugin's (PA5 and PA9 of specs/SPEC-backend-completion-plugins.md, amendment of 17 October 2026). The generic measure output's and parts' column names are PA5's; the change that creates those tables owns their final spelling and updates this file with it.

conventions.flow ids: Every flow id the Go join stores (flow_record.joined_flow_id, flow_record.copy_flow_id, connection_measured_volume.connection_flow_id) is recorded as the log_digest of the flow row it names, under the key joined_leg, copy_leg or connection_leg, so that an implementation storing the same legs under other ids compares value for value.
conventions.booleans: loss_detectable, counted_copy and final are recorded as 0 and 1, the Go join's BIGINT columns; after PA15 they are BOOLEAN, and 1 compares equal to true.
conventions.omitted: flow_record.provider_id, collection_gap.id and collection_gap.provider_id, and every aggregate's computed_at, are not recorded: they name the installation's rows or the computation's instant, not a decision.

flow_record.becomes: netflow.flow_record (the netflow plugin's own table, decided question 2)

columns.joined_leg: joined_flow_id, as the digest of the flow it names
columns.copy_leg: copy_flow_id, as the digest of the flow it names

connection_measured_volume.becomes: the generic per-connection measure output (PA5), rows whose measure is netflow

columns.connection_leg: connection, as the digest of the flow it names
columns.connection_start_at: the netflow plugin's own bookkeeping, beside the output
columns.records: the netflow plugin's own bookkeeping, beside the output
columns.final: the netflow plugin's own bookkeeping, beside the output
columns.due_at: the netflow plugin's own bookkeeping, beside the output
columns.computed_at: the netflow plugin's own bookkeeping, beside the output

unmatched_record_aggregate_<period>.becomes: the netflow plugin's unmatched counter table (PA4, PA9), one per period, columns unchanged

<family>_aggregate_<period>.becomes: the same family and period; the netflow columns become the parts of the measure named netflow (PA5)

columns.netflow_parts.<field>: the netflow measure's <field>, each field of the netflow_parts type under its own name
columns.every other column: unchanged: the family's key and its logged figures
